intelligence.heroSubtitle: Scan the void for the signals your dashboards never surface.
intelligence.capabilityBody: We architect ingest, enrichment, and alerting so your team acts before blind spots become problems.
capabilityHighlights: Custom agents parsing operational telemetry and document corpora.
Validated signals surfaced every 12 hours with confidence scores.
Human-readable summaries delivered in the style your team prefers.
intelligence.ctaSubtext: We schedule a 30-minute intelligence preview within two business days.

automation.heroSubtitle: Replace drudgery with deterministic automation loops.
automation.capabilityBody: We design automation paths that execute workflows with checkpoints, traceability, and forensic logs.
capabilityHighlights: Playbooks that run on a weekly cadence you control.
Ops time reclaimed and logged to a single source of truth.
Escalation hooks that keep humans in authority when needed.
automation.ctaSubtext: Expect a briefing within 24 hours to map the first automation loop.

productdesign.heroSubtitle: Interfaces that feel precise, not mysterious.
productdesign.capabilityBody: We refine every interaction path so humans understand what the AI is doing and why.
capabilityHighlights: Monospace layouts, sharp typography, and generous Ma for focus.
Clear prompt states, failure modes, and user guidance baked into the UI.
Rapid prototypes that move from schematic to ship-ready in days.
productdesign.ctaSubtext: We reply with a three-screen deck that shows the proposed flow.

connectors.heroSubtitle: Custom wiring that keeps every model synced with your stack.
connectors.capabilityBody: We build adapters for APIs, data stores, and compliance frameworks with predictable latency and monitoring.
capabilityHighlights: Latency budgets enforced with retries and circuit breakers.
Observability hooks for every signal crossing the connector.
Policy-as-code that ensures governance and audit readiness.
connectors.ctaSubtext: We share a wiring diagram within two business days.

components.heroSubtitle: Ready-to-use modular automation that ships faster.
components.capabilityBody: We curate reusable agents and workflows so each launch reuses trusted logic instead of starting over.
capabilityHighlights: Agent templates wired to your data and validation checks.
Workflow compositions that can be dropped into new products.
components.ctaSubtext: We demo the module set and share reuse recommendations.

governance.heroSubtitle: Control, oversight, and compliance over every run.
governance.capabilityBody: Runtime guardrails, monitoring, and auditing keep your AI fleet trustworthy.
capabilityHighlights: Monitoring dashboards with signal drift and latency alerts.
Escalation paths that keep executives informed without noise.
governance.ctaSubtext: We outline the monitoring and audit plan in 48 hours.
